name: Casey Rivera
headline: Backend engineer, Python and distributed systems
summary: Backend engineer with 6 years building data-heavy web services in Python. Led the migration of a monolith to event-driven services at Northwind Analytics and cut p95 API latency by 40%.

roles.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Led migration of a Django monolith to six FastAPI services communicating over Kafka, cutting p95 API latency from 820ms to 490ms.
Designed a PostgreSQL partitioning scheme for a 2TB events table, reducing nightly aggregation time from 3 hours to 25 minutes.
Introduced contract tests and a staged rollout pipeline; production incidents fell from 9 to 2 per quarter.
Mentored three engineers and ran the backend hiring loop.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built a route-optimisation API in Python used by 400 delivery drivers daily.
Wrote the Celery-based job pipeline that processed 1.2M shipment events per day.
Added OpenTelemetry tracing across services, cutting mean time to resolution by half.

projects.name: pgqueue
projects.description: Open-source PostgreSQL-backed job queue for Python with exactly-once delivery semantics; 600 GitHub stars.
